answer: A registration inlet charges each new agent a bond that grows quadratically with the number of identities funded from the same wallet cluster, so spawning a hundred sock puppets costs ten thousand times one honest signup. A rotating beacon committee publishes the funding graph weekly, and peers can challenge any suspicious cluster: a proven sybil garden forfeits its whole bond, half paid to the challenger. Honest agents pay once and trade freely, while mass identity farming becomes economically ruinous.
